_note: Twenty-one synthetic test enquiries for Team Sufra's agent, run against the real model. expect: draft (a quote awaits approval), ask (one question first, then the reply leads to a draft), handover (goes to the caterer), services (the agent lists Huda's menu and waits). items: the acceptable item sets with the quantities the code charges for; any other set counts as a wrong price. rush: whether the short-notice fee applies. then: a second client message after the first outcome, with then_status the state it must leave. group: what the case tests. Team Sufra, its users and every figure are fictional.
